benchmark.description: Four exposed 6 mm square sliders considered as equal-load independent cantilevers; ignores additional service props and guide/joint compliance. NOT a prediction or bound for the complete assembly.

clearances.comment: Clearance is not connector displacement; actual coupled free motion must be measured.

conclusion: Support pads and edge ribs improve the PCB support geometry, but do not establish the 20 N / 0.2 mm case-relative requirement. Full load paths, Sony boards, joints and uplift remain unverified.

physical_test.reference: Displacement indicator fixed to case, probe connector body; apply load with mating sacrificial plug/card fixture, not exposed contacts.
physical_test.acceptance: At 20 N, total connector displacement from unloaded position <=0.2 mm in each load case, no slipping/loosening/cracking, and no measurable residual displacement on unloading.
notes: Measure PCB displacement separately to identify support compliance.
Do not subject battery to test force.
Record material, print direction, temperatures, fastener torques, shims and actual gap.
First test mechanically equivalent dummy boards/connector fixtures; functional connector ratings must be confirmed before applying 20 N to electronics.
